verdict.rationale: jo explicitly supports scheduled recurring jobs ('Give jo a job and a schedule. Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time') and describes overnight autonomous work that reports back before you wake, delivered via its always-on cloud machine and multi-channel messaging (macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, email). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of scheduling reliability, no detail on one-off vs recurring task configuration UI, and no evidence of failure handling or notification mechanics beyond marketing copy.
